title: USF Interface Contract Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for interface contracts (API routes, commands, queries, event handlers, service boundaries, CLI interfaces, provider ports, adapter interfaces, internal/external contracts). Each declares its kind (interface-kinds), purpose, boundary, an input/output (request/response) contract, optional permission/security notes, and a reference to the semantic contract it realises. Interfaces are contract-first or contract-reconciled and MUST NOT be inferred from handlers when a contract exists. USF claims no full OpenAPI compliance until concrete OpenAPI artefacts exist. Governs the ontology concepts Interface, Service, and Port. lifecycleState draft; not active.

driftDetectable.$comment: Whether runtime-vs-contract drift can be detected for this interface.
